text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, while out with Tokai Teio—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Look at that crane game! Doesn't it look 
like so much fun?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Look look, they have Paka Petit too! It's 
super trendy right now, you know~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking where Tokai Teio was pointing, I 
saw a claw machine filled with plushies 
modeled after Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I'm not just good at dance 
games, I'm great at this one too!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
How about you, Trainer? Are you good at 
claw crane games?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Huh, is that so! Well then, why don't you 
show me what you can do?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!!
